checklist.why: Trunks, canopies and rocks each use one instances.* call (cylinder, cone, sphere) with a transforms array, so there are 3 instanced draws and no per-object meshes.
TREE_COUNT=8000 produces 8000 trunk and 8000 canopy transforms, and ROCK_COUNT=2000 produces 2000 rock transforms. That is 10,000 objects in total.
A fixed-seed LCG (seed 20240607) drives all placement, size and colour values. Math.random is never called.

Canopies and rocks get per-instance HSL colours through `colors`, on a white base material so the tint is not darkened. Trunks are a single colour. The probes are empty, so effectiveness is inferred from the source and the clean run.

The directional light has shadow:true, but no cast or receive flags are set on the ground or the instanced meshes. No shadow frustum bounds are set for a 170-unit scene either. The probes are empty, so no visible shadow is confirmed.
effects.fog with mode 'exp', density 0.0035 and a colour matching the scene background. The fog reaches roughly 30% at 100 units, so it should be visible. The run had no errors.
camera.orbit with autoRotate 0.08 around target [0,2,0], positioned at [0,52,92] with far=400. This frames the 58-radius forest and orbits slowly.
